```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
  library(here)
  library(knitr)
})
```

```{r}
conditions <- c("human-ai", "human-human", "ai-ai")

count_words <- function(x) {
  x <- str_squish(replace_na(as.character(x), ""))
  if_else(x == "", 0L, str_count(x, "\\S+"))
}

interaction_data <- map_dfr(conditions, function(condition) {
  df <- read_csv(
    here("data", condition, "interim", "interaction_level_stories_filtered.csv"),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  if (!"complete_exchange" %in% names(df)) {
    df$complete_exchange <- NA
  }
  if (!"analysis_turn" %in% names(df)) {
    df$analysis_turn <- NA_real_
  }

  df |>
    mutate(
      condition = condition,
      conversation_id = as.character(conversation_id),
      turn_index = coalesce(
        suppressWarnings(as.numeric(analysis_turn)),
        suppressWarnings(as.numeric(turn)),
        suppressWarnings(as.numeric(interaction_count))
      ),
      author_1_words = count_words(author_1),
      author_2_words = count_words(author_2),
      exchange_words = author_1_words + author_2_words,
      complete_exchange = as.logical(complete_exchange)
    )
})

story_lengths <- interaction_data |>
  group_by(condition, conversation_id) |>
  summarise(
    interactions_per_story = n(),
    max_turn_index = max(turn_index, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

story_summary <- story_lengths |>
  group_by(condition) |>
  summarise(
    mean_interactions_per_story = mean(interactions_per_story),
    mean_max_turn_index = mean(max_turn_index),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

interaction_summary <- interaction_data |>
  group_by(condition) |>
  summarise(
    stories = n_distinct(conversation_id),
    interactions = n(),
    complete_interactions = sum(complete_exchange %in% TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_turn_length_words = mean(c(author_1_words, author_2_words)),
    median_turn_length_words = median(c(author_1_words, author_2_words)),
    mean_exchange_words = mean(exchange_words),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

interaction_summary |>
  left_join(story_summary, by = "condition") |>
  select(
    condition, stories, interactions, complete_interactions,
    mean_interactions_per_story, mean_max_turn_index,
    mean_turn_length_words, median_turn_length_words, mean_exchange_words
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  kable(caption = "Filtered interaction-level dataset size and turn length by condition")
```
